turns.q: Can I change the shipping address on an order I just placed?
turns.replyTail:
anging a shipping address can change the taxes on your order, our customer care team has to update it directly and make sure any payment adjustments are handled securely.

Please call our team as soon as you can so they can look at your order and see what’s possible:

Our team can be reached at (800) 820-0465. We are available Monday–Friday 6:00AM–4:00PM and Saturday 8:00AM–4:00PM PST.

If you have your order number handy when you call, that will help them move quickly for you.
